name: Feral Mind
look: a primal white Mewtwo with long swept-back horns, a huge streaming dark teal mane over a mauve fur ruff, mauve belly and tail plates, a pink-finned tail and great fists bristling with glowing green crystals
entry: A Pokémon resembling Mewtwo, described in an old journal about a wild beast that ruled a crystal cavern long before people came. Crystals grow from its fists wherever its power gathers, and its mane bristles when it is angry.
how: Wild: very rare deep underground (below y -10).
